acceptance: The ratchet test fails on a fixture tree with a new copy of a helper body
The ratchet test passes on the tree with the count in go/.test-dup-baseline
The count goes down by the number of replaced copies, and the baseline goes down in the same commit
Old acs/ cycle directories older than the baseline date are not scanned
fix: Add a scanner that normalizes the body of each non-test function in each runtime test file and counts the extra copies of equal bodies. Write the count to go/.test-dup-baseline. Add a structure test that fails when the count is above the baseline. Scan an acs/ directory only when it is newer than the baseline date. Replace the first copies with standard-library calls, and lower the baseline in the same commit.
